name: inv-1-typescript-compiler-api-seam
description: The TypeScript compiler API enters engine code through exactly two pure seams of the owner-verification core (G5b, NFR-003, FR-011): engine/src/core/owner-verification/mutation-plan.ts (locating mutation sites) and engine/src/core/owner-verification/import-graph.ts (reading a module's import and re-export specifiers for sibling coverage). Both parse already-read text with ts.createSourceFile and never touch ts.sys, a Program or a language service. This rule refuses any other import, require or dynamic import of 'typescript' (or a 'typescript/...' subpath) outside tests.
fixHint: Do not import the TypeScript compiler API here. Call mutationPlan (engine/src/core/owner-verification/mutation-plan.ts) or moduleEdges (engine/src/core/owner-verification/import-graph.ts), or add the parsing you need to one of those two pure seams.
